decisions.reason: The portal is distant from the core display business and only mentioned briefly, so there is little sunk investment or visible commitment to justify keeping it.
The German Packaging Award and its fit with established display work create strong public commitment and success, making withdrawal unjustifiable.
The pegboard display is close to the established range and has its own page, signaling visible commitment and ongoing core fit.
The counter display is close to core offerings and publicly presented, so dropping it would write off visible investment without clear cause.
The freestanding display is close to the established offer and has a public page, sustaining commitment despite no reported results.
